pr_title: Add metrics@custom component template to metrics-*-* index template
pr_body:
This lets users customize the metrics data stream mappings, without having to override a managed component template that may get overridden.

Fixes #109475

issue_context.title: Add a metrics@custom component template for users to customize settings
issue_context.body:
### Description

Similar to how we extended logs in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/95469

Extend the `metrics-*-*` index template with this:
```
  "composed_of": [
   ...
    "metrics@custom"
  ],
  "ignore_missing_component_templates": ["metrics@custom"],
```

The effect of this is that if a user is not happy with our changes, they can created the metrics@custom component template and overwrite it. Because of the ignore_missing, the template does not have to exist.

We'll need to test what happens if a user creates this component template and tries to override a setting that we have also configured in metrics-settings. For example, setting ignore_malformed to false. Ideally, the user setting should take precedence then.

review_comments: Can you add javadocs to this, so that people that extend it know what it sets up and should be used for?
